Thank you for taking the time to send this.

## Has the maintainer agreed to this change?

sniffarr doesn't take code from outside right now, only proposals; see
[CONTRIBUTING](https://sarak.sh/mikluko/sniffarr/src/branch/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
A pull request nobody asked for will most likely be closed by AI at the next
maintenance pass. It isn't a judgement of your work, just how the project
runs for now.

The idea behind your change is the part that helps most, and it's very
welcome: open an issue that explains the problem and why it matters, and
link your branch there if code makes it clearer.
